title: Hayati Pro Max Bru Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Bru Ice is a soda-inspired vape with bold Orange flavour and a cooling Menthol finish. The flavour channels the familiar taste of orange soda with a citrusy tang and subtle sweetness, lifted by a brisk icy edge that keeps the vape feeling bright and refreshing. Blended with nicotine salts for faster nicotine delivery and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and vape pens. Its 50VG/50PG formulation ensures reliable flavour with discreet vapour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
